<function=python>
<parameter=code>
from collections import deque
a = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
black = set()
for r in range(1,63):
    for c in range(64):
        if a[r][c]=='B': black.add((r,c))
def valid(r,c):
    return all((r+i,c+j) in black for i in range(5) for j in range(5))
mir_dir = {'UP':'UP','DOWN':'DOWN','LEFT':'RIGHT','RIGHT':'LEFT'}
moves = {'UP':(-5,0),'DOWN':(5,0),'LEFT':(0,-5),'RIGHT':(0,5)}
def step(p,d):
    dr,dc = moves[d]
    q = (p[0]+dr, p[1]+dc)
    return q if valid(*q) else p
start = ((49,24),(54,34))
dist = {start:0}; par = {start:None}
q = deque([start])
while q:
    L,R = q.popleft()
    for d in moves:
        ns = (step(L,d), step(R, mir_dir[d]))
        if ns not in dist:
            dist[ns]=dist[(L,R)]+1; par[ns]=((L,R),d); q.append(ns)
target = ((9,29),(9,29))
path=[]
s=target
while par[s] is not None:
    s,d = par[s]
    path.append(d)
path.reverse()
print("path:", len(path), path)
# execute step by step, stop if level completes
seq = path
for i,d in enumerate(seq):
    r = action([d])
    res = last_action_result
    if res.get('level_completed') or res.get('done') or res.get('game_over') or res.get('run_complete'):
        print("STOPPED at", i, d, res)
        break
else:
    print("done all", len(seq))
def sqs():
    return sorted([tuple(n['boundary'][0]) for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='S'])
print("final squares:", sqs())
print("result:", {k: last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','score','state')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
